title: Playlist and Group Chat
author: Ansel Amberdale
blurb: Yara Sterling, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
